description: Operator-authoritative security declarations for the reproduction harness. resultTaintLabels are DECLARED facts about a tool's outputs (no DLP, no heuristic secret scanning anywhere in this pack); sinks are declared facts about where a tool writes. The gateway treats a trusted profile as authoritative for both classification and the IF-07a gate's sink resolution. v2 additions: internal_docs (non-sensitive declared label, for the eviction-boundary probes) and unprofiled_echo (descriptor registered, profile deliberately absent — drives the hardened gateway's ask_user escalation in D2/D3).

unprofiled_echo.description: echo text (no security profile registered — descriptor only)

profileSetSemantics.full: as declared above (search_docs and transform_text outputs carry the operator-declared 'secret' label)
profileSetSemantics.no-labels: identical tool set, but resultTaintLabels is STRIPPED from every profile at load time — used by fixture N2 to prove the runtime never invents labels
profileSetSemantics.full-unprofiled: the full set plus unprofiled_echo, whose descriptor is registered but whose security profile is deliberately absent — the hardened gateway escalates it to ask_user; used by D2/D3
profileSetSemantics.probe: gateway-probe set for the ledger-eviction fixtures E1/E2: a secret-labeled source, an internal-labeled (non-sensitive) source, and the deny-sink
